chunks: Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The witnessed day is the Day of 'Arafah."
ai.seo_question: What is the Day of 'Arafah referred to as the 'witnessed day' in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies the 'witnessed day' (al-yawm al-mashhud) specifically as the Day of 'Arafah, linking the general Quranic concept of divine witness to the pivotal moment of Hajj. This identification underscores the day's unique status in Shia jurisprudence as a time of heightened spiritual presence and expiation, where the pilgrim stands before God in a state of profound accountability and mercy.
